oe_qg2_act_tf_banner_expedition = {
	type = situation
	show_message = no
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			oe_qg2_is_host = yes
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			oe_qg2_is_host = yes
			gold >= 140
		}
	}
	cooldown = { type = oe_qg2_act_tf_banner_expedition_cd years = 3 }
	automation_tick = never
	ai_tick = never
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		interaction_source_list = { situation:oe_sit_three_feudatories = { add_to_list = source } }
		target_flag = recipient
		name = choose_situation
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { this = situation:oe_sit_three_feudatories situation_is_active = yes }
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			oe_qg2_init_host = yes
			add_gold = -140
			add_army_tradition = 5
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_qg2_mod_tf_expedition years = 5 mode = replace }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_qg2_tf_progress }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_progress add = 12 }
			clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_progress min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_qg2_tf_tension }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_tension add = -10 }
			clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_tension min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
}

oe_qg2_io_jurchen_great_hunt = {
	type = internationalorganization
	show_message = no
	potential = {
		scope:actor = { oe_qg2_in_jurchen_confederation = yes }
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			oe_qg2_in_jurchen_confederation = yes
			gold >= 60
		}
	}
	cooldown = { type = oe_qg2_io_jurchen_great_hunt_cd years = 5 }
	automation_tick = never
	ai_tick = never
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:jurchen_confederation
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			oe_qg2_init_host = yes
			add_gold = -60
			oe_qg2_add_cohesion = { amt = 8 }
			add_army_tradition = 6
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_qg2_mod_jurchen_aba_hunt years = 5 mode = replace }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:recipient = {
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { this = scope:actor } }
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_qg2_mod_jurchen_aba_hunt years = 5 mode = replace }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
}
